Why we're doing this

Technology is moving faster than most of us can keep up with. We feel it too.

More apps. More accounts. More updates. More setup. Somewhere along the way, simple things got harder, and talking to the people in the room got pushed aside by the screens in our hands.

We come from very different places: AI agent research at MIT, AI powered advertising at Google, and 18 years of delivery inside banking. But we kept coming back to the same question.

Can we make something a 10-year-old, or a grandma, can set up and use without any help?

That's v/h. Everyday devices that do one useful job, with the clever part kept inside. No app to download. No account to create. No subscription. You switch it on and it works.

Who we are

  • Vedh Krishnan

    Founder

    He knows where AI is heading next, because he's helping build it.

    Vedh works on the future of AI agents at the MIT Media Lab, with Project NANDA, the open source effort to build an internet of AI agents. He helps lead the research behind NANDA Town, a sandbox where agents learn to find and trust each other, and he coordinated NandaHack, which drew more than 400 builders.

    He knows what it feels like when something is too hard. He went from struggling with basic maths to studying calculus in a matter of months, then told that story on the TEDx stage. As a student he built an AI learning app and showed it to more than 300 people at Khan Lab School's AI in Education Summit.

    Vedh on LinkedIn ↗

  • Suraj Raman

    Founder

    He knows how to put a product in front of people, and make them care.

    Suraj was Regional Product Lead for Asia Pacific on Performance Max, Google's AI powered advertising product, working with agencies and advertisers across the region. He has spent more than 12 years in digital marketing, strategy and product.

    He loves teaching what he knows. He led GrowthSchool's performance marketing programme and teaches marketers how to use generative AI. He also cares about doing good with it: he spent nearly four years as a volunteer fundraising strategist for the education charity Make A Difference, and today champions sustainability.

    Suraj on LinkedIn ↗

  • Dhaval Patel

    Founder

    He turns complicated plans into things that ship, and work.

    Dhaval spent 18 years in financial services, running some of the biggest programmes at NatWest and Coutts. He delivered one of the largest transformation programmes and led simplification work across the organisation. Along the way he ran data migrations, implemented blockchain with startups, set up new organisations from scratch and led teams of more than 10 people.

    In a bank, things have to work every time, for every customer, and people have to trust them. That's the standard he brings.

    For the last year and a half he has been a founder, building AI products for people running startups, from notifications and integrations to document management. Most recently he has been an Entrepreneur in Residence at Antler. His focus never changes: take something complicated and make it simple enough to just work.

    Dhaval on LinkedIn ↗

Our test

If a 10-year-old can't set it up, it isn't finished.

Our first device is in development. We're sharing the thinking as we go, and we'd love to hear from you.
